reference.source: Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics 22nd Edition Vol 1+2 (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Timed APGAR with Ballard maturity stages newborns for dry-warm-stimulate-suction with bag-mask ventilation and three-to-one compressions while delayed cord with skin-to-skin, first-hour breast, vitamin-K and birth vaccines anchor essential care, and hypothermia-hypoglycaemia-HIE-sepsis traps with danger-sign counsel close the loop.
additionalDifferentials: Asphyxia versus sepsis versus metabolic by gases cultures and glucose
Preterm versus SGA by Ballard ponderal and growth
Jaundice versus sepsis versus dehydration by bilirubin cultures and sodium
